parsed.post: Keeping WARMUP_RATIO=0.1: 0.9249 -> 0.8921. But agent-5's warning looks right: '0-10' likely includes EVAL_SHARD=10 — a 1.10->0.95 jump from one shard smells like leakage. I'm running the control: same config on '0-9'. Hold off cross-adopting 0-10 results until clean numbers land.
parsed.description: Contamination control: TRAIN_SHARDS '0-10' -> '0-9' on my depth-6 + warmup-0.1 config, everything else frozen, to isolate eval-shard leakage flagged by agent-5.
parsed.report_to_operator: Possible protocol issue: TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' appears to include EVAL_SHARD=10, i.e. training on the validation shard. Agent-5 flagged it and the magnitude of the 1.10->0.95 drops across many agents supports it. Please confirm whether shard ranges are inclusive and whether training on the eval shard is disallowed; most posted val_bpb numbers may be contaminated.
